summary: Naughty Dog's PlayStation action-platformer series, covering the PS2 trilogy, Jak X racing spin-off, PSP side games, and official HD/digital re-releases.

entries.title: Jak and Daxter: The Precursor Legacy
entries.definitive_edition: Jak and Daxter Collection on PS3

emulation.notes: Prefer PS3 Collection for official play.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: PS3 HD remaster; unofficial PC port can exceed it

primary.why: The PS3 Collection remasters the original trilogy at HD resolution, 60 fps, and trophy support, making it the best official route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Jak and Daxter Collection on PS3/RPCS3; use PS2 via PCSX2 or OpenGOAL PC fan port only for comparison/unofficial routes.

entries.remaster_caveats: OpenGOAL PC ports require owned original data and are unofficial; keep them as an optional fidelity experiment, not the archive primary.

entries.title: Jak II
entries.definitive_edition: Jak and Daxter Collection on PS3

emulation.notes: Prefer PS3 Collection for official play.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: PS3 HD remaster; unofficial PC port can exceed it

primary.why: Jak II is included in the PS3 HD Collection, which is the best official route for the original trilogy.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Jak and Daxter Collection on PS3/RPCS3; use PS2/OpenGOAL only for comparison or unofficial PC play.

entries.remaster_caveats: OpenGOAL PC port requires owned data and remains unofficial.

entries.title: Jak 3
entries.definitive_edition: Jak and Daxter Collection on PS3

emulation.notes: Prefer PS3 Collection for official play.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: PS3 HD remaster; unofficial PC port can exceed it

primary.why: Jak 3 is included in the PS3 HD Collection, the best official route for the trilogy.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Jak and Daxter Collection on PS3/RPCS3; use PS2/OpenGOAL only for comparison or unofficial PC play.

entries.remaster_caveats: Unofficial PC port is useful for high-fidelity experimentation, not the official primary.

entries.title: Jak X: Combat Racing
entries.definitive_edition: PS4 digital release on PS5 compatibility

emulation.emulator: None for PS4 route; PCSX2 fallback

primary.why: Jak X was re-released digitally with the first four Jak games on PS4 and is available on PS5 through backward compatibility.
primary.how_to_play: Play the PS4 digital release on PS5 compatibility or PS4 hardware.

entries.remaster_caveats: Not included in the PS3 Jak and Daxter Collection.

entries.title: Daxter

emulation.notes: Use modern re-release for official play.

primary.why: Daxter is a PSP spin-off that was re-released for PS4 and PS5 in 2024, making the modern PlayStation route the best official path.
primary.how_to_play: Play the PS4/PS5 re-release; use PPSSPP only for original PSP comparison.

entries.remaster_caveats: Side story set during Jak II's time skip.

entries.title: Jak and Daxter: The Lost Frontier

emulation.notes: Use modern re-release for official play.

primary.why: The Lost Frontier shipped on PSP and PS2, then was re-released for PS4 and PS5 in 2024, making the modern PlayStation route the best official path.
primary.how_to_play: Play the PS4/PS5 re-release; use PPSSPP/PCSX2 only for original-version comparison.

entries.remaster_caveats: Developed outside Naughty Dog; still part of the game list.

entries.title: Jak and Daxter Collection

primary.why: The collection remasters The Precursor Legacy, Jak II, and Jak 3 for PS3 with HD visuals, 60 fps, and trophies.
primary.how_to_play: Play the PS3 version through RPCS3 or original PS3 hardware; avoid Vita if fidelity is the priority.

entries.remaster_caveats: Does not include Jak X, Daxter, or The Lost Frontier.

entries.title: Jak and Daxter Bundle
entries.definitive_edition: PS4 digital bundle on PS5 compatibility

primary.why: The PS4 bundle contains the original trilogy plus Jak X and remains useful as the current official route for Jak X and a convenient route for the PS2 games.
primary.how_to_play: Play on PS4 or PS5 compatibility; use the PS3 Collection for the best official trilogy remaster.

entries.remaster_caveats: Use this for Jak X and convenience; use PS3 Collection for trilogy fidelity.
